description: Every Shopper storefront in one CLI — catalog, cart, delivery schedule, charge calendar, and spend analytics no web UI surfaces.

tools.name: address_list_address
tools.description: List delivery addresses and which stores are available at each address. Returns the address.

tools.name: cart_add
tools.description: Add a product to the cart or increase its quantity. Required: id, quantity. Optional: engine. Returns the new cart.

tools.name: cart_list_summary
tools.description: Show current basket: items, quantities, totals, cashback, and minimum-order status. Returns the summary.

tools.name: cart_remove
tools.description: Remove a product from the cart or decrease its quantity. Required: id, quantity. Returns the new cart.

params.name: quantity
params.description: Quantity to remove (decrements; full qty removes the line)

tools.name: catalog_create_count
tools.description: Count products matching a search query and optional filters. Optional: query, brands, metadata (plus 1 more). Returns the new count.

tools.name: catalog_create_filters
tools.description: Get available filter options for a search query. Optional: query, brands, metadata (plus 1 more). Returns the new filters.

tools.name: catalog_create_search
tools.description: Search the product catalog by query with optional brand/type/metadata filters. Optional: page, query, brands (plus 2 more). Returns the new search.

tools.name: catalog_get_view
tools.description: Get details for a specific catalog banner. Required: banner_id. Returns the view.

tools.name: catalog_list_banners
tools.description: List promotional banners for the current store. Returns the banners.

tools.name: catalog_list_departments
tools.description: List product departments/categories for the current store. Returns the departments.

tools.name: catalog_list_news
tools.description: List new product arrivals for the current store. Returns the news.

tools.name: catalog_list_suggest
tools.description: Get search suggestions for a query prefix. Required: query. Returns the suggest.

tools.name: delivery_list_calendar
tools.description: Get delivery reschedule calendar — allowed date range and disabled days. Returns the calendar.

tools.name: delivery_list_summary
tools.description: Show scheduled delivery date, current delivery status, and store message. Returns the summary.

tools.name: features_create_select
tools.description: Select active store (sets session context; no-op for header-scoped reads). Required: store_id. Returns the new select.

tools.name: features_create_start
tools.description: Start a named feature timer. Required: name. Returns the new start.

tools.name: features_create_view
tools.description: Mark a feature toggle as viewed. Required: toggle. Returns the new view.

tools.name: features_list_stores
tools.description: List all available storefronts with store IDs, cluster IDs, payment parameters, and feature flags. Optional: toggles. Returns the stores.

tools.name: features_list_tick
tools.description: Get current timer state. Returns the tick.

tools.name: features_list_toggle
tools.description: Get active feature toggles for the current store. Returns the toggle.

tools.name: orders_list_orders
tools.description: List past orders for the active store (newest-first, paginated by size). Optional: size. Returns the orders.

tools.name: session_list_social
tools.description: Validate social-login session status. Returns the social.
